# flipctl-fonts

Set of pixel fonts adapted for **FlipCTL UI**

**Font folder structure:**
- TrueType binary `.ttf`
- Glyphs source file `.glyphs`
- LICENSE file

Each font has its **own license**. See each font below and the `LICENSE` file inside its folder.

## Fonts

### [HaxrCorp 4090](HaxrCorp4090-FlipCTL/)

Adaptation of *HaxrCorp 4089* by **sahwar** ([FontStruct](https://fontstruct.com/fontstructions/show/192981/haxrcorp_4089), 2009) - licensed [**CC BY-SA 3.0**](HaxrCorp4090-FlipCTL/LICENSE).

<img width="2934" height="1250" alt="image" src="https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/031e0dcb-8344-422a-8a49-7ac32b13401f" />

---

### [Born2bSportyV2](Born2bSportyV2-FlipCTL/)

New FlipCTL glyphs based on a public-domain font by **JapanYoshi** ([BitFontMaker2](https://www.pentacom.jp/pentacom/bitfontmaker2/gallery/?id=383)) - released as **Public Domain** via [**The Unlicense**](Born2bSportyV2-FlipCTL/LICENSE).

`**Important:** We removed non Latin glyphs since we don't need them in MCU mode.`

<img width="2934" height="1528" alt="image" src="https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/cbeadcce-c346-4fea-b8b7-45f027ba4f5b" />

---

### [Busy9px](Busy9px-FlipCTL/)

Minor glyphs adjustments for FlipCTL based on original work by **Yana Odobesku** & **Lunev Mikhail** (Flipper Devices) licensed [**MIT**](Busy9px-FlipCTL/LICENSE).

<img width="2934" height="1424" alt="image" src="https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/ec36bf9c-c86f-4442-aeb5-14738d843686" />

---

## Font editing

The `.glyphs` sources are edited in [Glyphs.app](https://glyphsapp.com)
